_comment: Live regions, grouped for display. Third Eye is a METHOD, not a Cairo
tool: it runs anywhere open data exists, and today it is pointed here.
Adding a city must be a config change, never a copy rewrite — so no UI
string names a place, and this file is the only place a place is named.
A group appears in the UI only if the pipeline actually produced cells
for at least one of its governorates. The status line therefore cannot
claim coverage the data does not have.
roadmap_note: More regions as the data allows.
